# Local chart libraries

These unmodified browser bundles let Live Server run the page without a CDN connection.

| Library | Version | Download |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Vega | 5.33.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega@5.33.0/build/vega.min.js |
| Vega-Lite | 5.23.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-lite@5.23.0/build/vega-lite.min.js |
| Vega-Embed | 6.29.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-embed@6.29.0/build/vega-embed.min.js |

Downloaded 10 October 2026. The original BSD licence and copyright notices are retained in the adjacent `*-LICENSE.txt` files. These bundles are third-party library code; the assignment page and its chart specifications are separate files.
